name: 役割とメンバーへの権限追加
prompt:
Faithfully recreate only the Japanese “new permission” component shown in the primary native preview. This is a precise reference reconstruction, not a redesign.

Use an exact 390x168 white canvas. Follow the Japanese native preview for all wording, positions, sizes, colors, row geometry and icon placement. At x16 near y12, place the small muted-gray section heading 「新しい権限」. Below it, use two clean white action rows, each about 57px tall, with a thin light-gray divider between rows and a quiet lower divider. Keep the exact row labels 「役割を追加」 and 「メンバーを追加」 in dark charcoal, medium-weight Japanese sans-serif. Place one simple forest-green outline plus at the far right of each row, aligned consistently near x356; keep the row labels left aligned around x16. Preserve the compact native spacing and straight white surface.

The original Discord screenshot is semantic context only; its blue Edit action, English text, left-side plus icons, other permission sections, avatars and navigation are outside this selected Japanese component. In the native Japanese preview, both labels are action controls and the plus icons are on the right. This crop contains no hyperlink text: do not color either action label blue. If an actual hyperlink were visible, only that linked text would be blue, but no such link appears here.

Do not add buttons with filled backgrounds, rounded cards, extra icons, avatars, roles, members, text, shadows or screen chrome. Use the native preview as the exact authority for this 390x168 crop and the original screenshot only to understand the meaning of adding a role or member.
